name: VRX Silica Limited
summary: VRX Silica Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the exploration, evaluation, and development of mineral properties in Australia. The company explores for gold and silica. It owns 100% interest in the Arrowsmith and the Muchea projects located to the north of Perth in Western Australia; and 100% interest in the Boyatup project located to the east of the port town of Esperance. The company was formerly known as Ventnor Resources Limited and changed its name to VRX Silica Limited in December 2018. VRX Silica Limited was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in West Perth, Australia.
